description: Cancel a confirmed booking, as the business does in the Forms app: Replo emails the person that it's cancelled, alerts the team, removes it from linked calendars and tells anyone waiting for that day that a time opened up. A past or already cancelled booking can't be cancelled. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").
